```esql
FROM books METADATA _score
| EVAL content = TO_TEXT(CONCAT(title, " ", description))
| FORK (WHERE year >= 2005 AND MATCH(author, "Tolstoy") | EVAL _score = 100.0 | LIMIT 1000) (WHERE year < 2005 AND MATCH(author, "Tolstoy") | LIMIT 1000)
| WHERE MATCH(content, "Karenina Tolstoy")
| KEEP book_no, _score, _fork
| SORT book_no
```
